description: Full entry for one service: docs, auth scheme and how the credential is sent, base URL, operations, MCP endpoint or repository (a repository must be installed; a docs-only server does not call the API), free plan vs trial, rate limits, data policy, notes, last-checked dates, link check, and separate signals: uptime (our availability probes of base URL and MCP endpoint), mcp_repo (archived, last push), mcp_registry (installs), product_reviews (rating, count, date range), sdk_downloads (official npm/PyPI SDKs per month), stackoverflow (question count), app_store (the vendor's iOS app) and github_issues (open vs resolved issues, median days to fix and issue_health 0-100 of the SDK, MCP and spec repos), each with its fetch date. Values carry the vendor page they were read from and a check date.
name: get_api
title: Get API details
